zh.text: 牛津大学位于英格兰牛津郡牛津市，是一所公立研究型书院联邦制大学。现有记录显示其教学始于1096年，1167年因亨利二世禁令而迅速发展。大学由43个学院及四个学术部门组成，无主校区，建筑散布于市中心。其教学结合学院小组辅导与中央系部课程，并运营阿什莫林博物馆及牛津大学出版社。

en.text: The University of Oxford is a collegiate research university located in Oxford, England. Teaching records date back to 1096, with rapid development beginning in 1167 after Henry II prohibited students from attending the University of Paris. The institution comprises 43 colleges and four academic divisions, lacking a main campus as buildings are scattered throughout the city center. Undergraduate education combines college tutorials with central faculty lectures. Oxford also operates the Ashmolean Museum and Oxford University Press.
